storyCards.headline: Too Late For Goodbyes: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Julian Lennon's "Too Late For Goodbyes" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Too Late For Goodbyes was released in 1984.

"Too Late For Goodbyes" by Julian Lennon.

Chart story — peaked at #5 on the Hot 100.
